data.name: Augusto
data.gender_notes: Augusto is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'augere', meaning to increase or grow, Augusto is a name that evokes a sense of majesty, power, and nobility. The name was borne by several Roman emperors, and its use continued into the Middle Ages and beyond. The name Augusto carries the meaning “Majestic, Venerable, Great” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Augusto usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, venerable, great and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes divine grace and strength.
data.etymology: Augusto belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Venerable, Great.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Augusto total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אוגוסטו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אוגוסטו נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'אוגוסטוס', שפירושה 'גדול, מכובד'. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'גדל', שפירושה 'להגדיל, להיות גדול'. השם אוגוסטו משקף את הרעיון של גדלות, חשיבות ומלכותיות, והוא מושרש במסורת הנוצרית והיהודית.

in_greek.name: Αυγούστος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αυγούστος προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'Augustus', που σημαίνει 'σεβαστός, μεγαλοπρέπειος'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με τη λέξη 'αὐγή', που σημαίνει 'αύρα, λάμψη'. Ο όνομα Αυγούστος αντανακλά την ιδέα της λαμπρότητας, της σπουδαιότητας και της μεγαλοπρέπειας, και έχει ιστορική σημασία στην παράδοση της αρχαίας Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Augustus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Augustos a Latina voce 'Augustus' derivatur, quod significat 'magnificus, illustris'. Est coniunctum cum verbo 'augere', quod significat 'crescere, augere'. Nomen Augustos reflectit ideam magnitudinis, dignitatis et gloriae, et in traditione Christiana et Latina radicatur.

in_english.name: Augusto

Historically, the name has been associated with Roman emperors and Christian saints, reflecting its significance in Western culture.
